# Branching (staghorn) coral: a short trunk and five 6-sided branches fanning up and out, tips a
# step lighter. About 1.2 m across, 1.1 m tall. Branches 0.18 m thick (two splats). Up Z.
new
material new Coral --base-color 0.624 0.957 0.898 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.4 --location 0 0 0.2
add mesh cone --name Br0 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.1 --radius2 0.07 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 0
apply --location
mode edit
select all
translate 0 0 0.4
mode object
set location 0 0 0.3
set rotation 0 32 0
duplicate
set rotation 0 28 72
duplicate
set rotation 0 35 144
duplicate
set rotation 0 25 216
duplicate
set rotation 0 33 288
add mesh cone --name Mid --vertices 6 --radius1 0.11 --radius2 0.07 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 0.75
select all
material assign Coral
active Trunk
join
apply
shade flat
export coral_branch.glb
